ctx.x: Yes, he is. He's another guy that -- he came up in those days with Fletcher. In fact, before I tell you about the writing part, Count was in Kansas City, you know, and used to be in the band out of Kansas City called Benny Moten. And his brother, Buster Moten, used to direct that band, and he played squeeze box, accordion.
It's Moten, isn't it -- I think.
